"""Independent dense kernels, genuine reference audits and durable JIT resume."""

import json
import runpy
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import FunctionType

import numpy as np
import pytest

jax = pytest.importorskip("jax")
jax.config.update("jax_enable_x64", True)
TOOLS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools"
JAX = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "prepare_jax_radau_resolvent.py"))
FIXTURE = runpy.run_path(str(Path(__file__).with_name("test_raw_radau_producer.py")))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("layout,advisory", [("c", False), ("fortran", True)])
def test_full_jax_kernel_and_startup_against_independent_dense_original(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, layout, advisory
):
    private = JAX["private_producer"]()
    original_main = private["main"]

    def durable_main():
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", [*sys.argv, "--durable-build"])
        original_main()

    control = FIXTURE[
        "test_complete_fresh_kernel_weights_and_causal_startup_match_dense_original_bem"
    ]
    run = FunctionType(
        control.__code__, {**control.__globals__, "PRODUCER": {**private, "main": durable_main}}
    )
    run(tmp_path, monkeypatch, layout, advisory)
    metadata = json.loads((tmp_path / "fresh/summary.json").read_text())
    assert metadata["jax_backend"]["original_audit_uses_scipy"]
    assert metadata["jax_backend"]["runtime"]["x64"]
    assert metadata["estimated_construction_array_peak_mib"] >= 512
    assert str(TOOLS / "prepare_jax_radau_resolvent.py") in metadata["frozen_inputs_sha256"]


def test_independent_audit_unwraps_jax_even_if_wrapper_assembly_is_unusable(monkeypatch):
    private = JAX["private_producer"]()
    model = FIXTURE["load_nodal_model"](
        FIXTURE["CASE"],
        max_panel_length=160,
        contact_panel_length=160,
        contact_end_length=160,
        corner_panel_length=160,
    )
    approximate = private["TRANSFER"](model, quadrature=12)

    def forbidden(s):
        raise AssertionError("Independent audit called the approximate backend")

    for prepared in approximate.prepared:
        monkeypatch.setattr(prepared, "assemble", forbidden)
    audit = JAX["OriginalAuditTransfer"](model, quadrature=12, prepared=False)
    audit.prepared = approximate.prepared
    assert all(type(a) is JAX["PreparedGalerkinOperators"] for a in audit.prepared)
    expected = FIXTURE["NodalInterfaceTransfer"](model, quadrature=12).evaluate(175 + 31400j)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(audit.evaluate(175 + 31400j), expected)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("field", ["runtime", "sources_sha256", "original_audit_uses_scipy"])
def test_backend_context_tampering_is_rejected_without_rewriting(tmp_path, field):
    frozen = {}
    JAX["initialize_context"](tmp_path, frozen)
    JAX["verify_context"](tmp_path, frozen)
    path = tmp_path / JAX["CONTEXT"]
    record = json.loads(path.read_text())
    record[field] = "tampered"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record))
    before = path.read_bytes()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="source, runtime or policy changed"):
        JAX["verify_context"](tmp_path)
    assert path.read_bytes() == before


def test_original_cache_requires_explicit_handoff_context(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "preflight.json").write_text("{}\n")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="explicit handoff"):
        JAX["verify_context"](tmp_path)
    assert sorted(p.name for p in tmp_path.iterdir()) == ["preflight.json"]


def test_durable_jax_resume_preserves_every_array_bit_and_readonly_verification(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    producer = JAX["private_producer"]()
    source = FIXTURE["source_metadata"](tmp_path)
    flags = [
        str(source),
        "--dt",
        "2e-6",
        "--duration",
        "32e-6",
        "--workers",
        "1",
        "--fft-rows",
        "2",
        "--combine-matrices",
        "3",
        "--spectrum-buffer-matrices",
        "4",
        "--startup-rows",
        "1",
        "--weight-layout",
        "fortran",
        "--max-workspace-mb",
        "512",
        "--max-memory-mb",
        "1024",
        "--durable-build",
    ]

    def execute(output, extra=()):
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["jax-prepare", *flags, "--output", str(output), *extra])
        producer["main"]()

    baseline, continued = tmp_path / "baseline", tmp_path / "continued"
    execute(baseline)
    journal = producer["CHECKPOINT"]["SamplingJournal"]
    original_commit = journal.commit

    def interrupted(self, name, *args):
        original_commit(self, name, *args)
        if name == "work-family0.npy":
            raise RuntimeError("injected committed JAX interruption")

    with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
        patch.setattr(journal, "commit", interrupted)
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="injected committed"):
            execute(continued)
    digest = producer["CHECKPOINT"]["digest_range"]
    before = {p.name: digest(p) for p in continued.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
    execute(continued, ["--resume", "--verify-resume-only"])
    assert {p.name: digest(p) for p in continued.iterdir() if p.is_file()} == before
    execute(continued, ["--resume"])
    for path in baseline.glob("*.npy"):
        actual, expected = np.load(continued / path.name), np.load(path)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(
            actual.ravel().view(np.uint64), expected.ravel().view(np.uint64)
        )
    with (
        np.load(baseline / "elastic.npz") as expected,
        np.load(continued / "elastic.npz") as actual,
    ):
        assert actual.files == expected.files
        for name in actual.files:
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[name], expected[name])
    record = json.loads((continued / "summary.json").read_text())
    assert [a["status"] for a in record["durable_construction"]["attempts"]] == [
        "interrupted_or_failed",
        "completed",
    ]

"""Copy verified original raw prefixes into a fresh, separately owned JAX build.

The source must have no active constructor and partial branches must be exactly
at a saved sampler boundary. Source files are opened read-only. Only committed
matrix ranges are inherited; future JAX writes cannot change the original.
No interpolation, constitutive or bitwise replay gate is relaxed.
"""

import argparse
import copy
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import runpy
import shutil
from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter

from finiteblock_bem.cq import CQPlan

TOOLS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
JAX = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "prepare_jax_radau_resolvent.py"))
BASE = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "prepare_raw_radau_resolvent.py"))
CHECK = BASE["CHECKPOINT"]
DIGEST = CHECK["digest_range"]
CONTROL_ARGUMENTS = {
    "output",
    "workers",
    "max_memory_mb",
    "max_workspace_mb",
    "preflight_only",
    "resume",
    "resume_receipt",
    "durable_build",
    "verify_resume_only",
}


@contextmanager
def readonly_source_lease(folder):
    path = folder / "construction.lock"
    if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Require the original regular construction lock file")
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        try:
            fcntl.flock(stream.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError:
            raise RuntimeError("The original constructor still owns its lease") from None
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            fcntl.flock(stream.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)


def verify_problem(parent, template):
    for key in ["plan", "source_mesh_arguments"]:
        if parent[key] != template[key]:
            raise ValueError("Handoff changes the physical problem or CQ plan: " + key)
    for key in ["source_sha256", "case_sha256", "restart_data_sha256", "numpy", "scipy"]:
        if parent["environment"][key] != template["environment"][key]:
            raise ValueError("Handoff changes a numerical input/runtime: " + key)
    first, second = parent["arguments"], template["arguments"]
    for key in (first.keys() | second.keys()) - CONTROL_ARGUMENTS:
        a, b = first.get(key), second.get(key)
        if key == "source":
            a, b = Path(a).resolve(), Path(b).resolve()
        if a != b:
            raise ValueError("Handoff changes a numerical construction argument: " + key)
    for path, expected in parent["frozen_input_sha256"].items():
        actual = DIGEST(path)
        if Path(path).resolve() == (TOOLS / "prepare_raw_radau_resolvent.py").resolve():
            if expected not in {actual, BASE["LEGACY_PRODUCER_SHA256"]}:
                raise ValueError("Unknown original producer migration")
        elif actual != expected:
            raise ValueError("Original numerical source/input changed: " + path)
    for path, expected in template["frozen_input_sha256"].items():
        if DIGEST(path) != expected:
            raise ValueError("JAX preflight input changed: " + path)


def aligned_prefixes(journal):
    count = journal.plan.fft_size // 2 + 1
    if journal.data["phase"] != "raw" or set(journal.data["channels"]) != {
        "work-family0.npy",
        "work-family1.npy",
    }:
        raise ValueError("Only an original raw construction can be handed off")
    prefixes = {}
    for name in journal.data["channels"]:
        prefix = journal.prefix(name)
        state = journal.data.get("sampler_states", {}).get(name)
        if 0 < prefix < count:
            if state is None or state["start"] != prefix:
                raise ValueError("Partial prefix is not at its saved sampler boundary")
            CHECK["validate_stack"](state["stack"], count, prefix)
        elif prefix == 0 and state is not None:
            if state["start"] != 0:
                raise ValueError("An empty branch has a nonzero saved start")
            CHECK["validate_stack"](state["stack"], count, 0)
        prefixes[name] = prefix
    return prefixes


def copy_committed_channel(parent, target, name, entry, plan):
    source = parent / name
    destination = target / name
    info = CHECK["header"](source, plan)
    with source.open("rb") as reader, destination.open("xb") as writer:
        writer.write(reader.read(info["offset"]))
        writer.truncate(source.stat().st_size)
        for chunk in entry["chunks"]:
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            offset = info["offset"] + chunk["first"] * plan.dofs**2 * 16
            left = (chunk["last"] - chunk["first"]) * plan.dofs**2 * 16
            reader.seek(offset)
            writer.seek(offset)
            while left:
                data = reader.read(min(left, 4 * 1024**2))
                if not data:
                    raise ValueError("Original committed matrix range was truncated")
                writer.write(data)
                digest.update(data)
                left -= len(data)
            if digest.hexdigest() != chunk["sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("Original committed chunk changed while copying")
        writer.flush()
        os.fsync(writer.fileno())
    if CHECK["header"](destination, plan) != info:
        raise ValueError("Copied spectrum header changed")


def clone_checkpoint(parent, target):
    begun = perf_counter()
    parent, target = Path(parent).resolve(), Path(target).resolve()
    protected = Path("/Volumes/Gauss-T7/tatva").resolve()
    if (
        parent == target
        or target.is_relative_to(parent)
        or parent.is_relative_to(target)
        or target.is_relative_to(protected)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Choose a separate owned target outside protected Tatva")
    expected = {"preflight.json", JAX["CONTEXT"]}
    if not target.is_dir() or {p.name for p in target.iterdir()} != expected:
        raise ValueError("Target must contain only a fresh JAX preflight and backend context")
    template_text = (target / "preflight.json").read_bytes()
    template = json.loads(template_text)
    if not template["arguments"].get("preflight_only") or not template["arguments"].get(
        "durable_build"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Generate the target with --durable-build --preflight-only")
    JAX["verify_context"](target)
    with readonly_source_lease(parent):
        parent_preflight_text = (parent / "preflight.json").read_bytes()
        parent_journal_text = (parent / "sampling-journal.json").read_bytes()
        original = json.loads(parent_preflight_text)
        if (
            Path(original["arguments"]["output"]).resolve() != parent
            or Path(template["arguments"]["output"]).resolve() != target
        ):
            raise ValueError("Checkpoint preflights identify different output folders")
        if "jax_backend" in original or (parent / "summary.json").exists():
            raise ValueError("Require an incomplete original-only raw build")
        verify_problem(original, template)
        plan = CQPlan(**template["plan"])
        journal = CHECK["SamplingJournal"](parent, plan, resume=True)
        prefixes = aligned_prefixes(journal)
        if template["required_disk_bytes"] > shutil.disk_usage(target).free:
            raise ValueError("Insufficient disk for the complete target construction")
        lease = CHECK["exclusive_lease"](target)
        try:
            for name, entry in journal.data["channels"].items():
                copy_committed_channel(parent, target, name, entry, plan)
            if (parent / "preflight.json").read_bytes() != parent_preflight_text or (
                parent / "sampling-journal.json"
            ).read_bytes() != parent_journal_text:
                raise ValueError("Original checkpoint metadata changed during the copy")
            snapshots = {
                "parent-preflight.json": parent_preflight_text,
                "parent-sampling-journal.json": parent_journal_text,
                "template-preflight.json": template_text,
            }
            for name, data in snapshots.items():
                with (target / name).open("xb") as stream:
                    stream.write(data)
                    stream.flush()
                    os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            manifest = dict(
                schema_version=1,
                utc=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                parent=str(parent),
                original_backend="original_scipy_galerkin",
                target_backend=JAX["BACKEND"],
                source_readonly=True,
                same_problem_verified=True,
                prefixes=prefixes,
                original_channel_chunks=copy.deepcopy(journal.data["channels"]),
                snapshots_sha256={name: DIGEST(target / name) for name in snapshots},
                copy_source_sha256=DIGEST(Path(__file__)),
                inherited_attempts_preserved=True,
                bitwise_prefix_replay_gate_unchanged=True,
                uncommitted_suffix_inherited=False,
            )
            manifest_path = target / "handoff.json"
            CHECK["atomic_json"](manifest_path, manifest)
            context = JAX["verify_context"](target)
            context["handoff"] = dict(path=manifest_path.name, sha256=DIGEST(manifest_path))
            CHECK["atomic_json"](target / JAX["CONTEXT"], context)
            updated = copy.deepcopy(template)
            updated["status"] = "inherited_raw_prefix_ready_for_jax_resume"
            updated["arguments"].update(
                preflight_only=False,
                durable_build=True,
                resume=False,
                resume_receipt=None,
                verify_resume_only=False,
            )
            updated["source_role"] = (
                "Verified original raw prefix inherited at sampler boundaries; future raw values use the frozen JAX backend."
            )
            updated["jax_backend"] = context
            updated["inherited_raw_prefix"] = context["handoff"] | {"prefixes": prefixes}
            for path in [
                target / JAX["CONTEXT"],
                manifest_path,
                *[target / name for name in snapshots],
                Path(__file__).resolve(),
            ]:
                updated["frozen_input_sha256"][str(path.resolve())] = DIGEST(path)
            allocated = sum((target / n).stat().st_blocks * 512 for n in journal.data["channels"])
            updated["additional_disk_bytes"] = max(0, updated["required_disk_bytes"] - allocated)
            CHECK["atomic_json"](target / "preflight.json", updated)
            copied = copy.deepcopy(journal.data)
            copied["preflight_sha256"] = DIGEST(target / "preflight.json")
            copied["backend_handoff"] = context["handoff"]
            CHECK["atomic_json"](target / "sampling-journal.json", copied)
            verified = CHECK["SamplingJournal"](target, plan, resume=True)
            if {n: verified.prefix(n) for n in verified.data["channels"]} != prefixes:
                raise ValueError("Copied journal prefixes changed")
            JAX["verify_context"](target)
            receipt = dict(
                status="verified_original_prefix_copied_for_jax_resume",
                prefixes=prefixes,
                parent=str(parent),
                target=str(target),
                source_files_opened_readonly=True,
                all_committed_chunks_verified_on_source_and_target=True,
                sampler_boundaries_exact=True,
                original_cache_modified=False,
                seconds=perf_counter() - begun,
                handoff_sha256=DIGEST(manifest_path),
                target_preflight_sha256=DIGEST(target / "preflight.json"),
                target_journal_sha256=DIGEST(target / "sampling-journal.json"),
                full_original_event_reproduced=False,
                same_accuracy_fem_advantage_verified=False,
            )
            CHECK["atomic_json"](target / "handoff-receipt.json", receipt)
            return receipt
        finally:
            lease.close()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("parent", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("target", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(clone_checkpoint(args.parent, args.target), indent=2), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Build fresh complete Radau CQ families without a source frequency spectrum.

Two raw-layer branches are sampled sequentially. Their disk arrays are then
converted in place to the compact families, retaining every requested lag,
the finite-DFT shift wrap and complete causal actuator startup. This prepares
a kernel; it does not establish nonlinear accuracy or an advantage over FEM.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import resource
import runpy
import shutil
import signal
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict, replace
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter, process_time

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import solve
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

from finiteblock_bem.cq import plan_cq
from finiteblock_bem.cq_storage import DiskSpectrum, spectrum_bytes
from finiteblock_bem.galerkin_fast import prepared_geometry_bytes
from finiteblock_bem.io import environment_record, fingerprint, write_json
from finiteblock_bem.nodal import NodalInterfaceTransfer, load_nodal_model

TOOLS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RAW = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "radau_raw_sampling.py"))
RADAU = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "radau_experiment.py"))
STORAGE = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "compact_radau_storage.py"))
NATIVE = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "prepare_native_resolvent.py"))
REPLAY = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "replay_resolvent.py"))
WORK = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "build_resolvent_history.py"))["compliance_in_work_coordinates"]
TRANSFER = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "trace_schur_experiment.py"))["TraceSchurTransfer"]
BUFFER = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "buffered_spectrum.py"))["BufferedSpectrumWriter"]
CHECKPOINT = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "radau_sampling_checkpoint.py"))
LEGACY_PRODUCER_SHA256 = "d56a13706c3d78d55958587b84650f268ab08ea056a3224840df5628063aa363"
ACTIVE_JOURNAL = ACTIVE_LEASE = None


def construction_arrays(
    model,
    plan,
    sampling,
    workers,
    quadrature,
    fft_rows,
    combine_matrices,
    startup_rows=8,
    spectrum_buffer_matrices=64,
):
    """Conservative array estimates for sequential phases, excluding OS cache."""
    meshes = [model.reference.moving, model.reference.stationary]
    d, steps, nfft = plan.dofs, plan.steps, plan.fft_size
    packet = sum(3 * m.dofs**2 * 16 for m in meshes)
    interpolation = (
        4 * (sampling.degree + 1) + 3 * sampling.check_points + 2 * workers + 4
    ) * packet
    geometry = sum(prepared_geometry_bytes(m, quadrature) for m in meshes)
    buffer = min(plan.fft_size // 2 + 1, spectrum_buffer_matrices) * d * d * 16
    solver = 32 * workers * (model.constraints.size**2 + sum(m.dofs**2 for m in meshes)) * 16
    rows = min(d, fft_rows)
    inversion = 4 * nfft * rows * d * 8 + 2 * (nfft // 2 + 1) * rows * d * 16
    inversion += (steps + 1) * rows * d * 8 + 4 * d * d * 8
    combine = 12 * combine_matrices * d * d * 16 + 64 * d * d * 16
    startup = 12 * nfft * min(d, startup_rows) * 16 + 8 * (steps + 1) * d * 8
    peak = (
        max(geometry + interpolation + solver + buffer, inversion, combine, startup) + 128 * 1024**2
    )
    return dict(
        peak=peak,
        interpolation=interpolation,
        inversion=inversion,
        combination=combine,
        startup=startup,
        geometry=geometry,
        solver=solver,
        spectrum_buffer=buffer,
    )


def _main():
    global ACTIVE_JOURNAL, ACTIVE_LEASE
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "source",
        type=Path,
        help="Case TOML or small mesh/case summary JSON; no source matrix is read",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--dt", type=float, default=2e-6)
    parser.add_argument("--duration", type=float, default=0.045)
    for flag in ["h", "contact-h", "contact-end-h", "corner-h", "restart-knot-window"]:
        parser.add_argument(f"--{flag}", type=float)
    parser.add_argument("--restart-knot-subdivisions", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--clear-restart-knots", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--quadrature", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--degree", type=int, default=16)
    parser.add_argument("--raw-rtol", type=float, default=1e-11)
    parser.add_argument("--output-rtol", type=float, default=1e-9)
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=int(os.environ.get("FDBEM_CORES", "1")))
    parser.add_argument("--fft-rows", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--combine-matrices", type=int, default=64)
    parser.add_argument("--spectrum-buffer-matrices", type=int, default=64)
    parser.add_argument("--startup-rows", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--primitive-partition", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--weight-layout", choices=["c", "fortran"], default="fortran")
    parser.add_argument("--max-workspace-mb", type=float, default=10240)
    parser.add_argument("--max-memory-mb", type=float, default=18432)
    parser.add_argument("--preflight-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--durable-build",
        action="store_true",
        help="Journal raw/compact matrices and retain original modes",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--resume", action="store_true", help="Continue this exact durable build")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--resume-receipt", type=Path, help="Explicit SHA256 receipt for a legacy raw prefix"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--verify-resume-only",
        action="store_true",
        help="Verify saved source, matrices and resources without modifying the build",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    publish = CHECKPOINT["atomic_json"] if args.durable_build else write_json
    output = args.output.resolve()
    if (output.exists() and not args.resume) or output.is_relative_to(
        Path("/Volumes/Gauss-T7/tatva").resolve()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Choose a fresh kernel directory outside protected Tatva")
    if (args.resume and (not args.durable_build or args.preflight_only or not output.is_dir())) or (
        (args.resume_receipt is not None or args.verify_resume_only) and not args.resume
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Resume requires an existing durable build; a legacy receipt is resume-only"
        )
    previous = None
    if args.resume:
        previous = json.loads((output / "preflight.json").read_text())
        if previous["arguments"].get("preflight_only"):
            raise ValueError("A preflight-only directory has no kernel construction to resume")
        if (output / "summary.json").exists():
            raise ValueError("A completed kernel does not require resuming")
        current = {k: str(v) if isinstance(v, Path) else v for k, v in vars(args).items()}
        for key, value in current.items():
            if (
                key
                not in {
                    "resume",
                    "resume_receipt",
                    "durable_build",
                    "preflight_only",
                    "verify_resume_only",
                }
                and previous["arguments"].get(key) != value
            ):
                raise ValueError(f"Resume changes the recorded argument: {key}")
        for path, expected in previous["frozen_input_sha256"].items():
            actual = fingerprint(path)
            if Path(path).resolve() == Path(__file__).resolve():
                if expected not in {actual, LEGACY_PRODUCER_SHA256}:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Unknown producer source migration; preserve the partial build"
                    )
            elif actual != expected:
                raise ValueError(f"Resume changes a numerical source/input: {path}")
    if (
        args.workers < 1
        or args.fft_rows < 1
        or args.combine_matrices < 1
        or args.startup_rows < 1
        or args.spectrum_buffer_matrices < 1
        or not all(
            np.isfinite(v) and v > 0
            for v in [args.dt, args.duration, args.max_workspace_mb, args.max_memory_mb]
        )
    ):
        raise ValueError("Require positive finite time and resource options")
    steps = round(args.duration / args.dt)
    if steps < 1 or abs(steps * args.dt - args.duration) > 1e-12 * max(args.duration, args.dt):
        raise ValueError("Duration must be covered by an integer number of time steps")
    begun, cpu_begun = perf_counter(), process_time()
    if args.source.suffix.lower() == ".toml":
        case = args.source.resolve()
        source = dict(
            source_mesh_arguments=dict(
                case=str(case),
                h=10,
                contact_h=2,
                contact_end_h=0.015625,
                corner_h=0.015625,
                quadrature=12,
                restart_knot_window=None,
                restart_knot_subdivisions=1,
                dt=args.dt,
                steps=steps,
                duration=args.duration,
            ),
            environment=environment_record(case),
        )
    else:
        source = json.loads(args.source.read_text())
    options, overrides = NATIVE["discretization_arguments"](source["source_mesh_arguments"], args)
    environment = environment_record(options["case"])
    keys = ["source_sha256", "case_sha256", "restart_data_sha256"]
    if any(source["environment"][key] != environment[key] for key in keys):
        raise ValueError("Source metadata differs from the current numerical package or case")
    if previous is not None and any(
        previous["environment"][key] != environment[key] for key in [*keys, "numpy", "scipy"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("Resume changes the numerical package, case, restart data or runtime")
    model = load_nodal_model(
        options["case"],
        max_panel_length=options["h"],
        contact_panel_length=options["contact_h"],
        contact_end_length=options["contact_end_h"],
        corner_panel_length=options["corner_h"],
        restart_knot_window=options.get("restart_knot_window"),
        restart_knot_subdivisions=options.get("restart_knot_subdivisions", 1),
    )
    d = 2 * len(model.moving_contact) + 1
    plan = plan_cq(d, args.dt, steps, max_memory_mb=1e9, disk_spectrum=True)
    if previous is not None and (
        previous["plan"] != asdict(plan) or previous["source_mesh_arguments"] != options
    ):
        raise ValueError("Resume changes the CQ plan or mesh configuration")
    sampling = RAW["RAW"]["RawSamplingOptions"](
        degree=args.degree, raw_rtol=args.raw_rtol, output_rtol=args.output_rtol
    )
    arrays = construction_arrays(
        model,
        plan,
        sampling,
        args.workers,
        options["quadrature"],
        args.fft_rows,
        args.combine_matrices,
        args.startup_rows,
        args.spectrum_buffer_matrices,
    )
    conversion = 0
    if args.weight_layout == "fortran":
        rows = min(
            d,
            32,
            int((args.max_workspace_mb * 1024**2 - 64 * 1024**2) // (2 * (steps + 1) * d * 8)),
        )
        if rows < 1:
            raise ValueError("Storage conversion budget cannot hold one time-weight row")
        conversion = 2 * (steps + 1) * rows * d * 8 + 64 * 1024**2
        arrays["peak"] = max(arrays["peak"], conversion + 128 * 1024**2)
    if (
        arrays["peak"] > args.max_memory_mb * 1024**2
        or max(arrays[k] for k in ["interpolation", "inversion", "combination"])
        > args.max_workspace_mb * 1024**2
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            f"Fresh Radau array estimate exceeds budgets: {arrays['peak'] / 1024**2:.1f} MiB"
        )
    names = [
        "radau_raw_sampling.py",
        "raw_layer_sampling.py",
        "seeded_raw_sampling.py",
        "trace_schur_experiment.py",
        "schur_condensation_experiment.py",
        "radau_experiment.py",
        "compact_radau_storage.py",
        "prepare_native_resolvent.py",
        "replay_resolvent.py",
        "build_resolvent_history.py",
        "fortran_weight_storage.py",
        "bounded_weight_conversion.py",
        "buffered_spectrum.py",
        "radau_sampling_checkpoint.py",
    ]
    frozen = {
        str(p.resolve()): fingerprint(p)
        for p in [Path(__file__), args.source, *[TOOLS / n for n in names]]
    }

    def check_source():
        current = environment_record(options["case"])
        if any(fingerprint(p) != v for p, v in frozen.items()) or any(
            current[k] != environment[k] for k in keys
        ):
            raise ValueError("Fresh Radau numerical source or input changed")

    weight_bytes = (steps + 1) * d * d * 8
    required = 2 * spectrum_bytes(plan) + 2 * weight_bytes + (steps + 1) * 8 * d * 8 + 1024**2
    if args.durable_build:
        required += 2 * spectrum_bytes(plan)
    if args.weight_layout == "fortran":
        required += weight_bytes + 8192
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    allocated = 0
    if args.resume:
        for name in [
            *CHECKPOINT["CHANNELS"],
            "weights0.npy",
            "weights1.npy",
            "weights0-fortran.npy",
            "weights1-fortran.npy",
        ]:
            path = output / name
            if path.is_file():
                allocated += path.stat().st_blocks * 512
    additional = max(0, required - allocated)
    if additional > shutil.disk_usage(output.parent).free:
        raise ValueError("Insufficient disk for both complete spectra, time weights and startup")
    if not args.resume:
        output.mkdir()
        publish(
            output / "preflight.json",
            dict(
                status="preflight_only_not_a_complete_kernel",
                arguments={k: str(v) if isinstance(v, Path) else v for k, v in vars(args).items()},
                source_metadata=str(args.source.resolve()),
                source_role="Mesh/case defaults only; no frequency values reused",
                source_mesh_arguments=options,
                plan=asdict(plan),
                history_dofs=d,
                stage_dofs=2 * d,
                estimated_array_mib={k: v / 1024**2 for k, v in arrays.items()},
                required_disk_bytes=required,
                additional_disk_bytes=additional,
                storage_conversion_array_mib=conversion / 1024**2,
                branches_sampled_sequentially=True,
                frozen_input_sha256=frozen,
                environment=environment,
                original_tatva_readonly=True,
            ),
        )
    if args.preflight_only:
        print(output / "preflight.json", flush=True)
        return
    if args.verify_resume_only:
        verified = CHECKPOINT["SamplingJournal"](
            output, plan, resume=True, receipt=args.resume_receipt
        )
        print(
            json.dumps(
                dict(
                    status="verified_checkpoint_not_running",

"""Experimental CPU-JIT batch assembly of the unchanged Galerkin form.

The quadrature and singular corrections are extracted from the original
assembler, not reimplemented. Frequency and ray coefficients are dynamic JIT
inputs. All bins must pass the existing empirical table checks; otherwise the
entire frequency uses the original factored NumPy assembler. No production
module or paid cache is modified. This is not a material/geometry AD interface.
"""

import ast
import copy
import inspect
import runpy
import textwrap
from collections import namedtuple
from functools import partial
from pathlib import Path
from types import FunctionType

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np

from finiteblock_bem import kernels
from finiteblock_bem.galerkin import ROTATION, GalerkinOperators
from finiteblock_bem.galerkin_fast import PreparedGalerkinOperators

TOOLS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RAY = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "ray_bessel_galerkin.py"))
FACTORED = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "factored_galerkin.py"))
FIELDS = "vector measure px py dx dy nx ny angular log integral log_moment".split()
Batch = namedtuple("Batch", FIELDS)
Material = namedtuple("Material", "mu lam density cs cp")


def _jax_copy(original):
    return FunctionType(original.__code__, {**original.__globals__, "np": jnp}, original.__name__)


_series = _jax_copy(kernels._difference_derivatives_series)
_tensor = _jax_copy(kernels._tensor_from_radial)
_traction = _jax_copy(kernels.source_traction)


def _pair(z, coefficients, first_exponent):
    """All arguments are on the validated ray and inside accepted table bins."""
    mantissa, exponent = jnp.frexp(jnp.abs(z))
    ids = exponent - 1 - first_exponent
    x = 4 * mantissa - 3
    zero = jnp.zeros((2, *z.shape), dtype=jnp.complex128)

    def step(index, carry):
        a, b = carry
        k = coefficients.shape[-1] - 1 - index
        return coefficients[:, ids, k] + 2 * x * a - b, a

    a, b = jax.lax.fori_loop(0, coefficients.shape[-1] - 1, step, (zero, zero))
    value = (coefficients[:, ids, 0] + x * a - b) * jnp.exp(-z)[None]
    return value[0], value[1]


def _radial_code(original):
    """Retain radial algebra; translate the data-dependent series assignment."""
    tree = ast.parse(textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(original)))
    expected = {
        "ks, kp = complex(s) / material.cs, complex(s) / material.cp": "ks, kp = s / material.cs, s / material.cp",
        "k0s, k1s, k0p, k1p = kv(0, zs), kv(1, zs), kv(0, zp), kv(1, zp)": "k0s, k1s = _pair(zs, coefficients, first_exponent)\n"
        "k0p, k1p = _pair(zp, coefficients, first_exponent)",
        "if np.any(small):\n"
        "    d1, d2, d3 = _difference_derivatives_series(r[small], ks, kp)\n"
        "    f1[small], f2[small], f3[small] = d1, d2, d3":
        # The inactive auxiliary input avoids large-power overflow. Actual
        # separations and all active series inputs remain unchanged.
        "auxiliary_r = np.where(small, r, 0.1 / np.abs(ks))\n"
        "d1, d2, d3 = _series(auxiliary_r, ks, kp)\n"
        "f1 = np.where(small, d1, f1)\n"
        "f2 = np.where(small, d2, f2)\n"
        "f3 = np.where(small, d3, f3)",
    }
    body = tree.body[0].body
    for before, after in expected.items():
        target = ast.dump(ast.parse(before).body[0], include_attributes=False)
        positions = [
            i for i, n in enumerate(body) if ast.dump(n, include_attributes=False) == target
        ]
        if len(positions) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Original radial source changed; re-audit the JAX adapter")
        index = positions[0]
        body[index : index + 1] = ast.parse(after).body
    function = tree.body[0]
    function.args.args.extend([ast.arg(arg="coefficients"), ast.arg(arg="first_exponent")])
    namespace = dict(np=jnp, _pair=_pair, _series=_series)
    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(tree), __file__ + "|radial", "exec"), namespace)
    return namespace[original.__name__]


_radial = _radial_code(kernels._radial)


def _batch_code(original):
    """Extract the original per-batch equations, stopping before global scatter."""
    tree = ast.parse(textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(original)))
    loops = [n for n in tree.body[0].body if isinstance(n, ast.For)]
    if len(loops) != 1 or ast.unparse(loops[0].target) != "b":
        raise ValueError("Original Galerkin loop changed; re-audit the JAX adapter")
    body = []
    for node in loops[0].body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Expr) and ast.unparse(node).startswith("np.add.at("):
            break
        if isinstance(node, ast.If) and ast.unparse(node.test) == "s is None":
            body.extend(copy.deepcopy(node.orelse))
        else:
            body.append(copy.deepcopy(node))
    if (
        not body
        or not isinstance(body[-1], ast.Assign)
        or ast.unparse(body[-1].targets[0]) != "local_k"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Original local block boundary changed; re-audit the JAX adapter")
    # Retrieve the reverse double-layer integral from its original scatter block.
    reverse = [
        n
        for n in ast.walk(loops[0])
        if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and ast.unparse(n.targets[0]) == "local_reverse"
    ]
    if len(reverse) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Original reverse block changed; re-audit the JAX adapter")
    header = ast.parse(
        "mu, lam = material.mu, material.lam\n"
        "log_green = -(lam + 3 * mu) / (4 * np.pi * mu * (lam + 2 * mu))\n"
        "log_derivative = 4 * mu**2 * (log_green + 1 / (2 * np.pi * (lam + 2 * mu)))\n"
        "effective_s = s\n"
    ).body

    # The extracted call receives the dynamic frequency-local coefficients.
    class Adapt(ast.NodeTransformer):
        def visit_Attribute(self, node):
            if ast.unparse(node) == "b.self_pair":
                return ast.copy_location(ast.Name(id="self_pair", ctx=ast.Load()), node)
            return self.generic_visit(node)

        def visit_Call(self, node):
            node = self.generic_visit(node)
            if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "_radial":
                node.args.extend(
                    [
                        ast.Name(id="coefficients", ctx=ast.Load()),
                        ast.Name(id="first_exponent", ctx=ast.Load()),
                    ]
                )
            return node

    footer = ast.parse("local_reverse = np.zeros_like(local_k)\nif not self_pair:\n    pass\n").body
    footer[-1].body = [copy.deepcopy(reverse[0])]
    function = ast.parse(
        "def batch(b, s, material, coefficients, first_exponent, self_pair):\n    pass\n"
    ).body[0]
    function.body = (
        header
        + body
        + footer
        + ast.parse("return local_v, local_k, local_d.reshape(p, 4, 4), local_reverse").body
    )
    module = Adapt().visit(ast.Module(body=[function], type_ignores=[]))
    namespace = dict(
        np=jnp,
        _radial=_radial,
        _tensor_from_radial=_tensor,
        source_traction=_traction,
        ROTATION=jnp.asarray(ROTATION),
    )
    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(module), __file__ + "|batch", "exec"), namespace)
    return namespace["batch"]

class JaxRayGalerkin(RAY["RayBesselGalerkin"]):
    """Bounded per-batch JIT work, original host scatter, explicit fallback."""

    def prepare(self, s):
        if not jax.config.x64_enabled:
            raise ValueError("The JAX Galerkin experiment requires JAX_ENABLE_X64=true")
        _, table = super().prepare(s)
        if not np.all(table.accepted):
            return (
                lambda: FACTORED["FactoredGalerkinOperators"].share(self.prepared).assemble(s),
                table,
            )
        material = Material(*(getattr(self.prepared.material, k) for k in Material._fields))
        # Uploaded once per frequency, not once per quadrature batch. np.asarray
        # below synchronizes every result, including first-call compilation.
        coefficients = jnp.asarray(table.coefficients)
        frequency = jnp.asarray(complex(s), dtype=jnp.complex128)
        first = jnp.asarray(table.first_exponent, dtype=jnp.int32)

        def evaluate():
            n = self.prepared.mesh.dofs
            vmat = np.zeros((n, n), complex)
            hmat, dmat = vmat.copy(), vmat.copy()
            for b in self.prepared.batches:
                args = Batch(*(getattr(b, k) for k in FIELDS))
                blocks = _local_blocks(args, frequency, material, coefficients, first, b.self_pair)
                local_v, local_k, local_d, local_reverse = [np.asarray(a) for a in blocks]
                np.add.at(vmat.ravel(), b.vindices, local_v)
                np.add.at(hmat.ravel(), b.hindices, local_k)
                np.add.at(dmat.ravel(), b.dindices, local_d)
                if not b.self_pair:
                    np.add.at(vmat.ravel(), (b.vindices % n) * n + b.vindices // n, local_v)
                    np.add.at(dmat.ravel(), (b.dindices % n) * n + b.dindices // n, local_d)
                    np.add.at(hmat.ravel(), b.reverse_hindices, local_reverse)
            hmat += 0.5 * self.prepared.mass
            return GalerkinOperators(vmat, hmat, dmat, self.prepared.mass)

        return evaluate, table

    def assemble(self, s=None):
        if s is None:
            return self.prepared.assemble(None)
        evaluate, _ = self.prepare(s)
        return evaluate()

    def statistics(self):
        return dict(
            backend="jax_x64_ray_batch_original_equations",
            whole_frequency_fallback_if_any_bin_rejected=True,
            original_host_scatter=True,
            original_small_argument_series_retained=True,
            dynamic_frequency_and_coefficients=True,
            fixed_table_material_or_geometry_derivatives_supported=False,
            uniform_error_certificate=False,
            production_backend_replaced=False,
        )
